_comment: Snapshot of https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/ — same site as practice-test-login fixture, but used here as the discovery target for the LLM-narrative .feature dialect. Locked alongside login.feature so the regression test stays hermetic.
title: Test Login | Practice Test Automation

accessibilityTree._note: Username input — no label, no placeholder, no aria-label. Only id='username'. Picker → locator('#username') → fieldName 'username'.
Password input — same shape as username.
Submit button — visible text 'Submit' becomes its accessible name. Picker → getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }) → fieldName 'submitButton'.
accessibilityTree.name: Submit

accessibilityTree._note: Error div — no role='alert'. Only id='error'. Picker → locator('#error') → fieldName 'error'.

accessibilityTree.text: Congratulations student. You successfully logged in!
